name: worker-mcp
description: Delegate tasks to local coding-agent workers through the worker-mcp MCP server, with a risk-gated approval flow.

allowed_roots.title: Allowed directories
allowed_roots.description: Comma-separated absolute directories a worker's cwd must lie in, for example /home/user/src

pi_path.title: pi binary
pi_path.description: Path to the pi binary, or just pi to find it on PATH

default_model.title: Default model
default_model.description: Model for workers spawned without one, as <provider>/<model>. Leave empty for none.
